# Bootstrap 5.3.3

Local copies of the version already used by this site, including the JavaScript
bundle with Popper. The local files remove the runtime dependency on jsDelivr for
Bootstrap styles, menus, and the portfolio modal.

Sources:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/twbs/bootstrap/v5.3.3/LICENSE

Keep the distributed copyright notices. Development source maps are not included.
